correctness.rationale: The generalized Aluthge transform maps positive bilateral weights w_k to w_k^{1−t}w_{k+1}^t. Iterating logarithms yields −a E|k+X_n|^α exactly. CLT with uniform moment bounds and strict minimization of E|Z+h|^α at h=0 yields logarithmic norm rate am_ασ_n^α for all α>0 (also α<1, using Gaussian unimodality rather than convexity). For α=1 a binomial absolute-deviation recursion and local Stirling give F_n(μ)=sqrt(2/π)σ+O(σ^{−1}); Berry–Esseen controls differences and a Gaussian center window of width sqrtσ, with domination justifying a full Schatten Riemann sum. For α=2 exact E(k+X)^2=σ²+(k+μ)² produces theta-sum formulas and irrational/rational lattice cluster sets. Independently verified quadratic identities with exact rational sums for n=5,15 and t=1/3,2/5; verified source check.py structure. Uniform p,α or whole spectral distribution beyond these claims not proved.
